manual.finding: Connection diagram and pin table show CLK, CMD and DAT0..3 through a level translator, without a separate mechanical socket WP connection.

findings: WPSL is SRS09 bit19 in the pinned Altera register definition.
The pinned Cadence vendor driver copies the standard U-Boot sdhci_ops; that table has no get_wp callback.
The MMC uclass returns ENOSYS for an absent get_wp callback; recovery writes succeeded on this card.
The old native driver unconditionally sampled bit19 for writable requests. This differs from the documented socket wiring contract.
hardware_finding: Write path rejected with ErrReadOnly after VERIFIED; exact raw present value and failed sector were not captured. Any partial native write remains unknown.
driver_fix: Trusted board NoSocketWriteProtect selection propagated through firmware-owned session; CSD permanent/temp protection and explicit expected writable identity remain separate.
